; and observed execution are independent of editorial names. Forced z:/a: addressing widths and .org
; execution views preserve the exact bytes. Only two one-byte .incbin spans remain structurally
; unknown; data formats can still be unresolved. A numeric table alias describes its consumer; it does
; not classify the target bytes. MMC1 values are serial register payloads, never effective 8KiB PRG
; bank indices. A routine may span several classification fragments with differing provenance.
; Shared work0..work7 and savedSlot are scratch, not stable game variables.
; Drawing queue records: [metasprite ID,X,Y,attribute XOR], four bytes each.
; Primary object: 21 bytes, twelve slots from objectState; every object field symbol
; names an absolute first-slot address and uses the same byte offset in X.
; Player shots: five six-byte records; secondary projectiles: twenty nine-byte records.
; Sound arrays use logical track X (0..5); hardware register offsets are a separate X.
; Credits repurpose gameplay RAM; credits/ending aliases name that banked contract.
; playerState values are mechanical states, with exact animation names tentative.
; Validated 16-byte iNES header: mapper 1, 128KiB PRG and 128KiB CHR, no trainer. Header bytes are not
; CPU instructions.
